description: Call this tool to read a bank CSV into the local ledger. Columns detected from headers (date, description, amount, currency, balance); amounts use the file's locale; stored lines skipped. Returns detected/stored/skipped.

account.description: Name for this account, e.g. "business EUR". Default: the file name without its extension. Later imports of the same account are deduplicated against it

bank.description: Bank profile. Default "auto": the headers decide. "generic" skips profile detection and uses the header heuristics alone

currency.description: Currency for rows where the file names none. Defaults to the shared business profile's default_currency, else EUR; the response says which it used

overwrite.description: Delete every transaction already stored for this account before importing, instead of merging. Use it when the bank reissued a corrected export

path.description: Name of a statement uploaded with bank_upload

name: statement_import
title: Import a bank CSV
